_comment: SGLang 0.5.21 fast regime: the disk tier is a tmpfs of ram_tier_bytes (same size for every arm), charged to the engine's cgroup, so memory.max adds it. The 10% fio health probe runs on the NVMe volume (probe_dir). HC-sel is HiCache file L3 with write_through_selective. kv_chunk_bytes is one HiCache page (64 tokens). sglang_patch_variant: the page-cache patch every SGLang arm runs with (fdatasync or sync_file_range), chosen by orchestrate.py hicache-pilot (its write size and threads in hicache_pilot). Capacities from capacities.json (qwen38_27b.measured, workloads v2); ram_tier_bytes = disk_bytes, so this fast cell is a harness example only (no host RAM holds that tier; plan 4.3 drops the Qwen fast cell). PLACEHOLDER values: the rest.
